name: To Love-Ru Darkness: True Princess
original_name: To LOVEる-とらぶる- ダークネス　トゥループリンセス
source: Time has passed since the Yami incident. As Rito spends his time lounging, he was presented with an unusual energy drink. Upon drinking it, Rito suddenly fainted. Everyone in the house later discovered that Rito has lost his memories. To get them back, he will need to reconcile with his friend's relationships...
translation: 雅米事件过去后，时间继续流逝。梨斗整天悠闲度日，某天有人送给他一瓶奇怪的能量饮料。他喝下后突然昏倒，家里人后来发现梨斗失去了记忆。为了找回记忆，他必须重新处理与朋友们的关系……
